name: @local/outliner
description: TypeScript port of Concord, Dave Winer / Small Picture's JavaScript outliner. Rewritten with no jQuery, no Bootstrap, and inline SVG icons instead of Font Awesome. GPL-3.0; derived from https://github.com/scripting/concord.

scripts.build:lib: vite build -c vite.lib.config.ts && vite build -c vite.compat.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.preview: npm run build:demo && vite preview --outDir dist-demo
